resolution: The 'better not the same' gap was resolution: the bake stretched 512px over a 120-tile chunk. Replaced baking with a per-fragment engine system (scene3d_ground_prefix/epilogue in shaders.zig + the ground pipeline in 3d.zig) so the ground is crisp at any zoom, O(1) memory, no resolution cap. Editor wired via Landform.tsx. Committed; needs a framework rebuild to take effect (see handoff file for Task #4 + verify steps).
